section_summary.extract_value: This section details the results of a multiple indirect effect model analysis, graphically represented in Fig. 1. The model examined the unique effects of positive body image mediating variables on mindful eating scores, controlling for multicollinearity. Key findings included the full model accounting for 20% of the variance in mindful eating scores, with specific beta weights reported for BMI, FFTQ-F, BAS-2, and FBApS. A significant indirect effect of family fat talk on mindful eating via functional body appreciation was observed, but not for general body appreciation (BAS-2) in the combined model.
